name: color-area
description: A color area allows users to visually select two properties of a color simultaneously. It's commonly used together with a color slider or color wheel.

documentBlocks.content: A color area allows users to visually select two properties of a color simultaneously. It's commonly used together with a color slider or color wheel.

Keyboard focus.

A color area can be navigated using a keyboard. The keyboard focus state enlarges the handle to become twice as large.

Handle behavior.

The color area's handle can slide all the way over the edge of the area. It always displays the selected color inside the handle and never gets cut off by the border or any container.

Minimum width and height.

Minimum sizing ensures that the component remains clear, usable, and visually consistent, even in flexible or responsive layouts.

Display color selection.

When using color areas, it's important to clearly display the color selection in real time. This can be in a color swatch, directly on the canvas, or both.

Color loupe on down/touch states.

The color loupe component can be used above the handle to show the selected color that would otherwise be covered by a mouse, stylus, or finger on the down/touch state. This can be customized to appear only on finger-input, or always appear regardless of input type.

color.description: The color whose two channels the area adjusts (S2 value). The gradient is computed from it and the channels. Accepts a CSS color string: #rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla(), hsb(), hsba() or transparent (the forms the ramp engine parses).

colorSpace.description: The color space of the two channels (S2 colorSpace). Defaults to hsb.

xChannel.description: The color channel on the horizontal axis (S2 xChannel). Must differ from yChannel.

yChannel.description: The color channel on the vertical axis (S2 yChannel). Must differ from xChannel.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Two-dimensional gradient surface; border is container styling.

anatomy.name: fill
anatomy.description: The lower channel layer of the area gradient, computed from the color and the channels.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: The upper channel layer, drawn over the lower one.

anatomy.name: color-handle
anatomy.description: Circular handle marking the selected color position.
